blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming programs design karne ka aik tareeqa hai jis mein objects aur classes istemal hote hain. Har object asal duniya ki kisi cheez ko dikhata hai jis ki apni properties (khusoosiyat) aur behaviours (kaam) hote hain. Classes templates (saanche) ki tarah hain jin se milti julti khusoosiyat wale bohat se objects banaye jate hain. OOP data aur behaviour ko achhi tarah sambhalne ke liye encapsulation, inheritance aur polymorphism par zor deti hai. Is tareeqe se asal duniya ke masail ka programming mein model banana asaan ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Procedural programming aur OOP ka muqabla (comparison) karta hua chart banayein. Students batayein ke kin suraton mein OOP zyada mufeed hai.

blocks.caption: Procedural programming aur OOP (class activity ke liye)
rows: Alag data par kaam karte functions (qadam)
Objects jo data aur methods ikatthe rakhte
Classes dobara use; inheritance se wasee
Data aam taur par har function ke liye khula
Encapsulation data ko methods ke peeche chhupati
Bare programs jo bohat si haqeeqi cheezon ka model banayein, jaise school ya bank system
